reasons.text: Idealo exact query for 'Bosch PSR 18 LI-2' returned a different model, Bosch PSR18V-60, at €86.30 with 23 offers; the claimed €129 price may be for an older or different kit.
No independent tests and no review count are available for the claimed PSR 18 LI-2; the 4.7-star average is unverified.
Failure reports are sparse and mostly concern the PSB 18 LI-2, not the PSR 18 LI-2; one PSR motor/trigger failure is not enough to judge reliability.
Cheaper alternatives with more review evidence exist: Bosch GSR 18V-65 at €78.99 (76 reviews, 31 offers) and Makita DDF482 at €168.99 (39 reviews, 53 offers).
